annotations.label: NVD stops scoring most CVEs
annotations.detail: NIST's NVD stops adding its own scores to most new CVE records; the CNA's and CISA's scores are used instead.

annotations.label: BOD 26-04: US 3-day KEV deadline
annotations.detail: US federal agencies must fix the worst newly listed KEV flaws within three days. A policy marker, not a defender series.

annotations.label: Linux kernel batch
annotations.detail: The Linux kernel CNA published 429 CVE records on 19 July and 9 on 20 July.
